research_repo.note: metric CSVs are untracked run outputs; the commit identifies the scripts

x: mean ASI of the condition (robust_curves.csv column x); the first point of every curve is the unattacked result at ASI 0
y: TPR@1%FPR (%) from detection.csv (far = 0.01; post-hoc rows with n_eval = 100, the 100-identity open-set score)
point_format: [mean ASI, TPR@1%FPR (%), severity label]; chains: [mean ASI, TPR@1%FPR (%)]
summary_note: summary.aursc_all_attack_types and obs_min_at_0_2 follow make_tables.py: normalized area over ASI [0, 0.2] averaged over all 28 attack types (14 single types + 14 chains), and the lowest measured TPR@1%FPR among conditions with mean ASI <= 0.2. Values are fractions, not percent.
